user_intent: A single wide-angle architectural shot of a modern Kay-Twelve learning space showing all three RSC zones — high-energy collaboration (left), transition (center), low-energy focus (right). The space must feature BOLD, SATURATED furniture colors: teal, lime green, cobalt blue, yellow. Editorial, clean, bright natural light. No grey metal, no neutral beige.

scene.location: A modern open-plan elementary school learning environment with three clearly distinct spatial zones. LEFT HIGH-ENERGY ZONE: tall standing-height collaborative tables with BRIGHT YELLOW laminate tops on white metal frames, surrounded by LIME GREEN upholstered tall stools and TEAL hexagonal ottomans on casters; a full whiteboard wall covered in colorful student sketches and diagrams. CENTER TRANSITION ZONE: open polished concrete floor corridor with COBALT BLUE lightweight mobile chairs on casters mid-movement; a small YELLOW accent table on wheels. RIGHT LOW-ENERGY ZONE: large TEAL upholstered soft lounge chairs, LIME GREEN floor cushions, a low open wood bookshelf filled with colorful books, warm pendant lighting overhead. Room features: polished concrete floors that reflect color, white walls with bold multi-colored horizontal stripe accent bands (teal, yellow, orange, purple), large windows with natural light pouring in, recessed LED ceiling lights. The overall palette is bold and vibrant — teal, lime green, cobalt blue, yellow — not grey, not beige, not neutral.
